title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Purchase Experience team is seeking a full stack software development engineer with a passion for engineering excellence. We offer you the opportunity to deliver and lead high visibility & high-impact innovation for customers across the Cart application services in Amazon. We extend to you the opportunity to develop upon multi-tiered, low-latency, highly resilient distributed systems on a grand scale. You will play a pivotal role in crafting solutions that profoundly enhance the shopping experience, handling vast data volumes, delivering lightning-fast response times, and simplifying the cart process to a remarkable degree. You must understand the importance of quality and testability in regards to the long term health and operational excellence of the Amazon eco system and you will be expected to drive improvements to current and future systems in these areas. You will contribute to both funcational and non-functional aspects of the application in the form of enhacing customer experience, improving latency, performance, and business investigations. You will learn and grow by working closely with senior engineers across our organisation.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have excellent technical design, problem solving, Computer Science fundamentals, and communication skills. The candidate should be comfortable interacting with technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels. The ability to work backwards and think from a customer perspective is crucial as the ideal candidate is expected to contribute to the product vision in addition to the technical design and implementation.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and develop full-stack solutions for Cart/Checkout services, considering scalability, performance, and reliability across multi-tiered distributed systems
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, and operations to understand customer needs and translate them into technical implementations
* Investigate and optimize system performance, latency, and resource utilization through data-driven analysis and experimentation
* Contribute to code quality and system testability by establishing best practices, conducting thorough code reviews, and identifying areas for improvement
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and participate actively in design and architecture discussions

A day in the life
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll work on full-stack solutions that handle massive transaction volumes while maintaining lightning-fast response times. Your day might include collaborating with product and design partners to understand customer pain points in the post add to cart experiences, writing and reviewing code for distributed systems that process millions of requests, investigating performance bottlenecks to optimize latency, and participating in design discussions with engineers across our organization. You'll balance building new features with strengthening the foundational systems that keep our services reliable and resilient. Beyond coding, you'll contribute to our culture of operational excellence by identifying opportunities to improve system quality, testability, and long-term health.
  
  
**About The Team**
We're a collaborative group of engineers passionate about delivering seamless post add to cart and cart experiences for Amazon customers worldwide. Our team focuses on building the infrastructure and services that make purchasing simple and dependable, even during peak shopping periods. We work closely with engineers at all levels across the organization, learning from one another and sharing knowledge to solve complex distributed systems challenges. Together, we're committed to continuously improving how customers interact with our platform, and we're excited to have someone join us who thinks deeply about both technical excellence and customer impact.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Progressive Discovery and Monetization
description:
**Description**
Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon — the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future.
  
  
The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and improve EE business economics — and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day.
  
  
This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product — we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll build discovery and recommendation features, brand-facing advertising surfaces, and the backend services that power them. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership.
  
  
We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build — the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design, build, and own software end to end — from customer research through design, code, testing, deployment, and production operations.
  
  
Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions that improve how customers find and buy everyday essentials.
  
  
Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer and brand problems into products that ship worldwide.
  
  
Use generative AI tools and modern engineering practices to raise quality and velocity, and coach teammates on getting the most from them.
  
  
Own operational health for your services — monitor metrics, drive root-cause fixes, and keep improving the experience for customers and brand partners.
  
  
Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find better everyday-essentials products faster, or how to give brands a more effective way to reach shoppers or how to improve the profitability of the business. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on — and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, help customers find better options and to improve the business economics along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast-moving group solving open-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers — a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems

**About The Job**
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. GoKwik is India’s leading D2C Commerce Growth Platform, helping 15,000+ brands acquire, convert, engage, and retain shoppers. Powered by a network of 200M+ shoppers, 500M+ checkouts, and 1.5B+ customer conversations, we’re building the operating system for commerce growth.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer III to build and scale the core backend platform that powers merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and integrations with eCommerce platforms such as Shopify and WooCommerce.
  
  
The role involves designing reliable, scalable backend services, making architectural decisions, and improving the performance and operational efficiency of production systems. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to build reusable platform capabilities, reduce manual interventions, and support the growing needs of merchants. You will also contribute to technical direction, engineering standards, and the development of other engineers on the team.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  

* Backend Platform Development: Design, develop, and maintain core backend services and reusable platform capabilities for merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and external integrations.
* System Design and Architecture: Own low-level and high-level designs for shared services. Make decisions around APIs, data models, failure handling, performance, scalability, and maintainability, and document design decisions clearly.
* Distributed Systems and Kafka: Design and operate event-driven systems using Kafka, including topic and partition strategies, consumer groups, message ordering, idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, consumer lag monitoring, and schema evolution.
* System Performance and Optimisation: Improve SQL query performance, caching, queuing, and service efficiency. Investigate production bottlenecks and implement solutions that address root causes.
* Platform Integrations and Data Synchronisation: Build reliable, bi-directional integrations with eCommerce platforms and external systems. Use patterns such as outbox, change data capture (CDC), reconciliation jobs, and backfills while accounting for third-party API rate limits.
* Scalability and Multi-Tenant Architecture: Design systems that support multiple merchants reliably, including data partitioning and sharding, workload isolation, backpressure management, and appropriate consistency models.
* Production Reliability and Observability: Own production reliability through on-call support, incident response, root-cause analysis, postmortems, and service-level objectives (SLOs). Use observability and application performance monitoring tools, including SigNoz, to identify and resolve issues.
* Infrastructure and Cost Optimisation: Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure costs, manual support work, and recurring merchant-specific fixes without compromising system reliability or delivery speed.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to plan delivery, communicate technical decisions and risks, review designs, and manage production priorities.
* Technical Leadership: Lead design reviews, establish engineering standards, review critical changes, and mentor SDE I and SDE II engineers. Contribute to technical direction across teams and promote clear documentation and execution practices.
* AI Systems and Engineering Tools: Apply AI-assisted development tools where appropriate and demonstrate an understanding of AI system design, including LLM inference, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, agents, and guardrails.

Who You Are
  
  

* Have 6+ years of software engineering experience in a product or platform company, with hands-on ownership of production backend systems.
* Have strong low-level and high-level system design skills and can evaluate trade-offs, justify architectural decisions, and take accountability for outcomes.
* Have extensive hands-on experience with Kafka in production, including partitioning, ordering guarantees, consumer groups, rebalancing, delivery semantics, idempotency, dead-letter queues, lag monitoring, and failure recovery.
* Have experience designing and scaling high-throughput systems, with measurable examples of improvements in throughput, latency, data volume, or system capacity.
* Possess strong distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency and availability trade-offs, sharding, rate limiting, backpressure, and graceful degradation.
* Have a solid understanding of SQL databases, data modelling, transactions, indexing, query optimisation, caching, and queuing systems.
* Have practical experience with production ownership, on-call responsibilities, incident management, reliability targets, root-cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions.
* Have experience with application performance monitoring and observability tools, preferably including open-source solutions such as SigNoz.
* Have demonstrated the ability to optimise database queries and infrastructure costs.
* Can communicate technical designs, document services, manage technical stakeholders, and explain complex engineering decisions clearly.
* Are proficient in Node.js or Golang and their associated frameworks, or have strong experience in one of these languages with the ability to contribute to the team’s technology stack.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, data-driven decision-making, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving problems.
* Have experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical standards and engineering practices.

Why GoKwik
  
  
At GoKwik, you will work on core commerce technology that supports a growing ecosystem of D2C brands. You will have the opportunity to solve complex backend and distributed systems challenges, shape platform architecture, improve production reliability, and influence engineering practices across teams. The role combines hands-on development with technical leadership and offers the opportunity to build scalable, reliable systems that support the next phase of commerce growth.

TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Transunion is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join Trusted Call Solutions team who will be responsible for developing and delivering mission critical services in the field of voice and data applications to global carriers and enterprises. The ideal engineer would be working in a fast-paced DevOps environment with an entrepreneurial mindset of solving real world problems by designing, developing and maintaining features, solutions and scalable production grade micro-services in collaboration with other product and engineering teams. * Bachelor’s (B.S) or Master’s (M.S) degree in Computer Science or related field
* Minimum 5+ years of software development experience
* Minimum 3+ years of object-oriented design and object-oriented programming experience

* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional organizations including system architects, project managers, product managers and operations.
* Manage and execute integration tests with potential customers/partners/participants using a cloud based international test bed.
* Follow Agile development methodology leveraging tools like GIT (SCM), JIRA (User Stories), SLACK (Auto Notifications/Channels)

* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Familiarity with Documentation-as-Code practices.
* Knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, security best practices, and authentication frameworks.

* Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to present technical concepts to architects and developers.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

* Experience with Geospatial Information Systems (GIS) or web mapping.
* Experience within the telecommunications and/or utilities industries.

* Knowledge of Node.js design and development.
* Experience with enterprise integration, particularly web services.
* Experience developing mobile applications (iOS, Android, Windows).
* Experience working in an Agile environment.

title: Identity Development Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of almost 900 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team helps protect the EY brand and build client trust.
  
  
Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.
  
  
**The opportunity**

* As an experienced Full Stack .Net Developer, within the Identity and Access Management (IAM) function you will:
* Lead the delivery of solution or infrastructure development services for small to large size projects, using strong technical capabilities with exceptional hands on experience!
* Designs, develops and is responsible for the maintenance of solutions or infrastructure work using standard methodologies and best practices for new features or modifications to existing features and functions.
* Role is an individual contributor, though may be asked to manage project aligned teams in their collaborative efforts and provide informal mentoring/coaching to junior members of the team
* Partners and collaborates with peers across Development & Engineering and Architecture teams, as well as external vendors such as Microsoft, as needed to understand, agree and plan the specific code modifications and enhancements vital to achieve the agreed development objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Leads the delivery of high-quality solution or infrastructure work, setting project timelines and continuously reviewing and updating the specifications, in line with user requirements
* Contributes to complex aspects of a project, performing coding, debugging, testing and troubleshooting throughout the development process
* Resolves intensified production and system enhancement issues
* Provides technical expertise to improve value from current solutions, infrastructure and emerging technologies and seeks to continuously improve internal processes
* Fully understand user requirements and translates requirements into design specifications
* Drives alignment to the relevant processes, procedures, standards, technical design
* Communicates all the ongoing activities and results to business sponsors, stakeholders, and management as part of knowledge sharing and reporting
* Work and provide expertise in developing applications in N Tier, MVC, and SOA Architectures using .NET Framework 4.5+ and Visual Studio 2015 or above.
* Creates or collaborate in the creation of visual mockups, prototypes, and diagrams, as well as performs or directs testing for compatibility in order to achieve an integrated architecture across interdependent technologies

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Experience in building web application with the ASP.NET framework and design/architectural patterns (e.g. Model-View-Controller (MVC)
* Experience in Power Shell scripting
* Experience in building Web services using REST, WEB API, WCF, ASMX.
* Experience in writing stored procedures and complex queries. LINQ is a plus.
* Experience in using ORM tool like Entity Framework or NHibernate.
* Experience in building UI layer using client-side frameworks like jQuery, Angular.
* Knowledge of SOLID principles and its implementation.
* Knowledge of HTML, CSS, Bootstrap is a plus.
* Understanding of Agile methodologies
* Strong attention to detail
* Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills
* Able to work well in a team setting

**To qualify for the role you must have**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or equivalent work experience
* 5 years of development experience using C# .NET, MVC and Web API, jQuery and angular

**Ideally, you’ll also have**
Maintains a proactive approach to learning about Identity and Access Management aligned components within Information Security (IS) such as Microsoft Identity Management (MIM) and infrastructure such as the Active Directory technical environment, and Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP)
  
  
**What We Look For**
We’re looking for someone who can collaborate globally with different regions and cultures. Problem-solves, thinks creatively and has an open mind to new insights. Focus on customer service and building positive relationships with colleagues both across teams and globally. A highly motivated, diligent, and driven individual who seeks development and improvement opportunities and deliver quality services.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Software Engineer III – Data Platform and Analytics
description:
**Summary**
Our Product Development & Operations (PDO) organization builds and runs the cloud platform that powers how P&C insurers around the world do business, with a strong focus on AI, cloud, and data platform adoption. You will join the Data Platform and Analytics team, which delivers secure, scalable data services that enable mission-critical insights for our customers. We work in an inclusive, collaborative environment using modern cloud-native technologies to solve complex data and distributed systems problems.
  
  
As a Software Engineer III, you will design and build cloud-native data and analytics services that sit at the heart of Guidewire’s platform strategy. You will use your expertise in modern Java, microservices, and frontend technologies like React or Angular to create large-scale, real-time data and analytics capabilities in the public cloud. This role is a key contributor to PDO’s priorities around operational excellence and transformative innovation, directly advancing Guidewire’s mission to combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to transform how the world’s P&C insurers do business.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you’ll do**

* Design, develop, and operate cloud-native data platform and analytics SaaS services that are secure, scalable, and reliable, supporting PDO’s focus on operational excellence and data platform adoption.
* Build and maintain large-scale, real-time stream processing and data ingestion systems that power analytics, data science, and reporting for our customers.
* Design, implement, and run microservices-based solutions using modern Java and frameworks such as Spring Boot, applying microservices and domain-driven design patterns.
* Contribute to intuitive, performant user experiences using modern frontend technologies (React.js or Angular, HTML, CSS, JavaScript) for data and analytics workflows.
* Own CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation for your services, leveraging containers and Kubernetes to ensure fast, safe, and repeatable releases.
* Take responsibility for availability, performance, observability, and data security of your services, including triaging and resolving production issues and defects.
* Maintain secure coding practices, address application security findings, and collaborate with Security and platform teams to support strong governance and compliance goals.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

**Required**
**What you would need to succeed:**

* Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.
* 6+ years of relevant software engineering experience building production-grade services or applications.
* Experience designing and developing backend services in Java, ideally with Spring Boot, and familiarity with microservices and multithreading concepts.
* Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, and performance optimization techniques, especially in distributed or data-intensive systems.
* Strong programming skills in JavaScript and at least one modern frontend framework such as React.js or Angular, with solid knowledge of HTML and CSS.
* Working knowledge of relational databases (such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar) and experience with data warehousing technologies such as Amazon Redshift or equivalent.
* Familiarity with microservices architecture patterns such as service discovery, API gateways, and domain-driven design.
* Ability to thrive in an agile, fast-paced environment, collaborating across functions and locations in a transparent, inclusive way.
* Clear, respectful communication skills and a growth mindset, with a willingness to learn new tools, domains, and ways of working.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with AWS or another major public cloud provider (e.g., IAM, networking, managed databases, streaming services).
* Experience building and operating containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes; familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
* Exposure to building large-scale real-time data streaming or event-driven systems (e.g., Apache Kafka, Kinesis, or similar).
* Experience with observability and logging stacks such as ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as TeamCity or similar systems.
* Understanding of distributed systems principles (consistency, availability, durability, reliability, fault tolerance, consensus algorithms) and how to apply them in production systems.
* Experience with AWS RDS or other managed relational database services.

**Your Impact**
We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first six months, you will take ownership of one or more data platform or analytics services, deep dive into our architecture and tooling, and deliver features that enhance real-time data processing, scalability, and user experience. You will help improve service reliability, harden security, and evolve CI/CD pipelines, directly contributing to PDO’s goals around secure, efficient, and AI-ready cloud operations and data platforms.
  
  
As your expertise grows, your work will influence how insurers unlock insights from Guidewire Data Platform and analytics products, shaping customer outcomes and contributing to Guidewire’s broader mission to transform P&C insurance with cloud, analytics, and AI.
  
  
**About Guidewire**
Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.
  
  
As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
  
  
For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\\_PandC.
  
  
Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.
